2.120.6
ChartAxis.ChartAxisTitle
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartAxis.ChartAxisTitle element specifies the title of a ChartAxis. This element is optional.
This element is of type ChartAxisTitle.
Following is the parent element of the ChartAxis.ChartAxisTitle element.
Parent elements
ChartAxis
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartAxis.ChartAxisTitle element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartAxisTitle" type="ChartAxisTitleType" minOccurs="0" />
